seal.statement: Implement the five Scenario A deep-stack throughput and latency optimizations: (1) propagate bound params into SELECT ... FOR UPDATE reservation checks, merge WHERE equality-bound PK columns with projected row columns in resolveCanonicalPkTuples, and preserve params/orderBy/limit in queryMatchingPkRows; (2) skip redundant retainParticipantSet mutations when the participant set is unchanged and skip transient pre-RPC participant status writes (PREPARING, COMMITTING, ROLLING_BACK) in persistDistributedTransactionParticipantRow; (3) batch concurrently queued proposals per Ready cycle in RaftRsRuntimeOwner and expose batching telemetry in RaftRsDurableStore; (4) extract canonical primary-key row identities for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE in checkAndRecordSessionRowKey and allow row-key-disjoint sessions to PREPARE and COMMIT across intermediate disjoint commits on the same partition; and (5) validate disjoint-row staged writes in O(1) without O(N^2) prefix replay when generation and schema_version are unchanged.

text: Implement all five Scenario A deep-stack throughput and latency workstreams: (1) pass bound params through executeSelectOwned -> finalizeSelectSuccess -> executeLockingReadReservations, merge WHERE equality-bound PK columns with projected row columns in resolveCanonicalPkTuples, and preserve params/orderBy/limit/offset in queryMatchingPkRows; (2) skip redundant retainParticipantSet mutations when newlyEnlisted is empty and participantSetText is unchanged, and skip transient pre-RPC PREPARING/COMMITTING/ROLLING_BACK participant status writes in persistDistributedTransactionParticipantRow; (3) batch concurrently queued propose commands per Ready cycle in RaftRsRuntimeOwner and expose batching sync telemetry in RaftRsDurableStore; (4) derive canonical PK row keys for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE in checkAndRecordSessionRowKey and allow row-key-disjoint concurrent sessions to PREPARE and COMMIT across intermediate disjoint commits on the same partition; and (5) validate disjoint-row staged writes in O(1) without O(N^2) prefix replay when generation and schema_version are unchanged, plus guard probe, unit suite, and v0.3.4 release metadata.

Rejected on Checklist A.6 and C.2: (1) PREPARED_PARTICIPANT_ROW_KEYS must be cleaned up on participant rollback, prepare/commit refusal, zero-op commit, and session discard/expiry, and unscoped commits must block canAdvanceRowKeySessionGeneration; (2) guard and test suite must assert PREPARED rollback row-key cleanup, overlapping row-key conflict refusal, and same-row/SELECT session replay. All other checklist items approved.

Addressed independent verifier Checklist A.6 and C.2 findings: added clearPreparedParticipantRowKeys on prepare/commit refusal, zero-op commit, prepared rollback, absent rollback, non-retryable prepare failure, and session expiry/discard; added SCOPED_COMMIT_GENERATIONS and areIntermediateGenerationsScoped to prevent advancing generationBase across unscoped intervening commits; added witness assertions for prepared-rollback row-key cleanup, overlapping row-key conflict refusal, and same-row write + session SELECT replay in guard and test suite; updated release metadata to 0.4.0.

Independently verified Attempt 2 against concurrency-serialization.md (A.1-A.6), recovery-replay.md (B.1-B.6), and owner-interaction.md (C.1-C.2): confirmed PREPARED_PARTICIPANT_ROW_KEYS cleanup on rollback/refusal/zero-op commit/expiry across partition-participant-transaction-apply.js, partition-participant-transaction-request.js, and partition-participant-transaction-session.js; confirmed SCOPED_COMMIT_GENERATIONS prevents advancing generationBase across unscoped intervening commits; confirmed witness assertions in guard and test suite pass deterministically.
